qremesher.remesh.description:
Remesh the selected mesh.
 It also downloads and installs the RemesherEngine the 1st time, if needed.

uvpackmaster4.adjust_texel_density_to_un.description: Adjust texel density of the selected islands so it is uniform with texel density of the unselected islands

uvpackmaster4.apply_grouping_to_scheme.description: Create or extend a manual grouping scheme using the currently selected automatic grouping method

uvpackmaster4.auto_repack.description: Repack all objects and UV maps configured for the process. Press the Help button to learn more

uvpackmaster4.group_by_similarity.description: Group all selected islands by similarity and save generated groups in a grouping scheme

uvpackmaster4.load_grouping_scheme_prese.description: Load Grouping Scheme from a file

uvpackmaster4.move_group_info.description: Move the active group up/down in the list

uvpackmaster4.move_grouping_scheme_box.description: Move a target box to an adjacent tile

uvpackmaster4.new_group_info.description: Add a group to the active grouping scheme

uvpackmaster4.numbered_group_reset_ipara.description: Unset the group assignment for the selected islands (the islands will not belong to any group)

uvpackmaster4.numbered_group_select_ipar.description: Select / deselect all islands which are assigned to the group determined by the 'Group Number' parameter

uvpackmaster4.numbered_group_select_non_.description: Select all islands which are assigned to any group

uvpackmaster4.numbered_group_set_free_ip.description: Assign the selected islands to the first free group (the lowest group not currently used by faces in the UV map)

uvpackmaster4.numbered_group_set_iparam.description: Assign the selected islands to the group determined by the 'Group Number' parameter

uvpackmaster4.numbered_group_show_iparam.description: Show group numbers the selected islands are assigned to

uvpackmaster4.pack_mode_help.description: Show help for the currently selected packing mode

uvpackmaster4.remove_group_info.description: Remove the active group from the scheme

uvpackmaster4.reset_island_manual_group.description: Reset the group assignment for the selected islands

uvpackmaster4.save_grouping_scheme_prese.description: Save the active grouping scheme to a file

uvpackmaster4.select_island_manual_group.description: Select / deselect all islands which are assigned to the active group

uvpackmaster4.select_islands_in_grouping.description: Select/deselect islands in the active box

uvpackmaster4.set_engine_path.description: Set a path to the UVPM engine

uvpackmaster4.set_grouping_scheme_box_to.description: Set a target box to a UDIM tile as defined by the 'Tile (X)' and 'Tile (Y)' parameters

uvpackmaster4.set_island_manual_group.description: Assign the selected islands to the active group

uvpackmaster4.set_pixel_margin_tex_size_.description: Set Texture Size to one of the suggested values

uvpackmaster4.set_rot_step_group.description: Set Rotation Step to one of the suggested values

uvpackmaster4.set_texel_density.description: Set texel density for the selected islands. Texel density to set is determined by the 'TD To Set' option

uvpackmaster4.show_texel_density.description: Show texel density of the selected islands

uvpackmaster4.uv_show_manual_group_ipara.description: Show the names of all groups the selected islands are assigned to

arp.arp_export_fbx_panel.description: Export the rigged character to Fbx file format

arp.arp_export_gltf_panel.description:
Export the rigged character to Gltf/Glb file format
Requires Blender 3.4 and higher

arp.auto_scale.description:
Automatic scale of the source armature to fit the target armature height
May not work if the rest position is incorrect, the height is calculated on this basis. Scale manually otherwise.

arp.batch_retarget.description:
Select multiple source animations for retargetting.
If "In Place" is enabled, process and select only In Place actions

arp.bind_to_rig.description:
Bind selected meshes to rig.
Select first the meshes, then the armature

arp.check_rig_export.description: Check the rig to find possible export related errors

arp.export_config.description: Export the bones mapping to file

arp.export_data.description: Dev mode only! Export internal rig data into file (bone transform constraints values)

arp.export_rig_data_options.description: Export rig data (reference bones, custom shapes)

arp.fix_rig_export.description: Fix the rig issues automatically when possible(set stretch to 0, disable Preserve Volume...)

arp.guess_facial.description:
Guess facial markers with deep learning.
Still experimental, works best with standard facial design, may not always output accurate results

arp.guess_fingers.description:
Guess fingers with deep learning.
Longer to run the first time

arp.guess_markers.description:
Guess markers with deep learning (symmetrical characters only for now)
Longer to run the first time

arp.match_to_rig.description: Generate the final rig from the reference bones

arp.remap_update.description: Update Remap settings to latest version

arp.retarget.description: Retarget the source armature action to the target armature

arp.retarget_bind_only.description: Retarget, binding only without baking for quick preview

arp.retarget_synchro_select.description: Select in the bones list the active bone in the viewport

arp.toggle_action_remap.description: Enable or disable this action from export

arp.unbind_to_rig.description: Unbind the selected meshes from the rig
